Getting started

This guide walks you through installing the library, writing your first program and running it from the command line.

The page keeps this sentence up to date while you read.

Note

Every example on this page runs with python3 on Linux and macOS without extra packages.

Installation

  1. Download the archive from the release page and unpack it somewhere safe.
  2. Add the bin folder to your PATH.
def area(radius):
    """Return the area of a circle with the given radius."""
    # Multiply by pi and the squared radius.
    return math.pi * radius ** 2
